cards.title: Draft file by file migration phases

rg export -g "*.js" -n
rg import -g "*.js" -n
rg node: -g "*.js" -n
touch migration-phases.md

cards.title: Plan lockfile and type-check gates

node --version
node --check src/index.js
npx eslint .
touch ts-gates.md

cards.title: Plan TypeScript config and test migration

find . -name "*.test.js" -type f
rg node:test -g "*.js" -n
rg vitest -g "*.js" -n
touch tsconfig-plan.md

cards.title: Run chart data examples from Python docs

python -m pytest -q docs/tests/test_signups.py
cat docs/examples/signups.py

cards.title: Check chart docs use colour roles

rg -n -e '--accent' docs
rg -n -e 'status' docs
rg -n -e 'status' -C 2 docs

cards.title: Rewrite chart titles from labels to claims
cards.when: Use this when a chart section in Python docs has a title like a filename or chart label.
cards.cmds:

sed -i 's/ chart//g' docs/*.rst
rg -n -e '[A-Za-z-]+ chart' docs
rg -n -e 'doubled' docs

cards.title: Verify one axis and direct labels in docs
cards.when: Use this when a Python docs page describes a line, bar, or small-multiple chart and you must check axis rules.
cards.cmds:

rg -n -e 'two y-axes' docs
rg -n -e 'tick' docs
rg -n -e 'legend' docs

cards.title: Plan Rust migration steps before touching code

cargo check --all-targets
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

cards.title: Inventory affected Rust files for an ops migration
cards.when: Use it when the model must identify which Rust files a migration will touch.

cat Cargo.toml
rg -e migration -e schema -e migrate .

cards.title: Draft phase and dependency plan for Rust migration
cards.when: Use it when the plan needs ordered phases with dependencies and rollback notes.

mkdir -p plans/migrations
touch plans/migrations/2026-01-01-queue-drain.md
cat Cargo.toml

cards.title: Verify migration plan gates with Rust commands

cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
cargo test

cards.title: Verify one C file compiles warning free

cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null

cards.title: Verify the C project test target passes
cards.when: Use it after editing tests or code in a Makefile based C project.
cards.cmds:
test -f Makefile
make test
find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*test.c'

cards.title: Build a C test binary with sanitizers
cards.when: Use it when memory errors or undefined behavior must be caught before review.

test -f copy.c
cc -std=c11 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -o test_bin test.c copy.c
test -f test_bin
file test_bin

bash -c ./test_copy
rg -n 'assert' test_copy.c

cards.title: Capture CSS custom property tokens from stylesheets
cards.when: Use this card when you need to document design tokens declared in CSS files.
cards.cmds:

rg --no-heading --line-number --color never --glob '*.css' -e '--' src

cards.title: Capture HTML class usage from markup templates
cards.when: Use this card when you need to document class names used by HTML or Vue components.
cards.cmds:
find src -type f -name '*.html'
rg --no-heading --line-number --color never --glob '*.html' --glob '*.vue' -e 'class(Name)=' src

cards.title: Capture cascade risk from CSS layer and important markers
cards.when: Use this card when you need to document cascade decisions that override normal CSS order.

printf 'Breakpoint, Component, Utility\n'

psql -d scratch -f schema.sql
psql -d scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM active_users"

cards.when: Use when a SQL schema change must be captured as a safe, repeatable migration before implementation.
cards.cmds:
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql
psql -d scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM users"
psql -d scratch -c "SELECT column_name, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'users'"

cards.when: Use when a slow SQL query needs an index and the expected plan must be captured before coding.

psql -d scratch -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'users'"

psql -d scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM active_users"

python -m pytest -q

python -m pip check
python -m pytest -q -k parse_port
python -m pytest --collect-only -q -k parse_port

cards.title: Verify C release UI doc examples

make test

make test

cards.when: Use it when a C program emits JSON from CLI, web, API, pane, and ops surface for the same feature and clients depend on stable keys.

jq -S . examples/api-out.json

python -m pytest -q

cards.when: Use after changing authentication, signing, or configuration in Python services.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.py' -not -path './.git/*'
rg -n -e api_key -e passw -e secret -e token . --glob '*.py'
rg -n -e os.environ -e os.getenv -e environ . --glob '*.py'
rg -nF -e ' = ' . --glob '*.py'

env SEED=1234 python -m pytest -q

rg -l -e 'LEFT JOIN' -e 'RIGHT JOIN' -e 'FULL OUTER JOIN' --glob '*.sql'

cards.when: Use when you need shell code constants for the compact thresholds.
cards.cmds:
echo 'COMPACT_THRESHOLD_200K=160k'
echo 'COMPACT_THRESHOLD_1M=250k'
echo 'SOURCE_PATH=references/context/strategic-compact.md'
grep -n '160k' references/context/strategic-compact.md

cards.title: Capture injection points in SQL entry paths
cards.when: Use when a new feature will read user data into SQL queries.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.sql'
grep -n execute src

cards.title: Capture safe migration design for SQL changes
cards.when: Use when designing a schema change that affects production data.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.sql'
grep -n users db/migrate
sqlite3 :memory: .read schema.sql

cards.title: Capture tenant isolation checks for SQL queries
cards.when: Use when designing queries that return rows across tenants or users.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn tenant src
grep -in select src
pytest -q tests/sql

cards.title: Capture sensitive data labels for SQL fields
cards.when: Use when designing a schema that stores personal data or secrets.
cards.cmds:
grep -in email schema.sql
grep -in encrypt schema.sql
cat schema.sql

cards.title: Review C error paths for silent failures
cards.when: Use this when reviewing C code that returns error codes or handles memory.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'return -1' src
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only src/foo.c
make test

cards.title: Design C fallback behavior explicitly
cards.when: Use this when designing a C helper that returns defaults or sentinel values.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'safe_copy' src
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only src/safe_copy.c
make test

cards.title: Verify C error propagation before approval
cards.when: Use this when a C function returns codes that wrap library calls.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'errno' src
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -c src/wrapper.c
make test

cards.title: Check C resource cleanup on failure paths
cards.when: Use this when reviewing C code that allocates, opens, or locks resources.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'malloc' src
grep -n 'fopen' src
grep -n 'free' src
make test

cards.title: Type-check JS and TS migration files
cards.when: Use when a migration change includes JavaScript or TypeScript files that must compile before review.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only -- src/migrations
tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
eslint src/migrations

cards.title: Check migration order and file pairs
cards.when: Use when a migration adds, renames, or splits migration files in a JS or TS project.
cards.cmds:
ls src/migrations
rg -n "function up" src/migrations
rg -n "function down" src/migrations

cards.title: Scan migration code for unsafe queries
cards.when: Use when a JS or TS migration executes database queries or passes user-controlled values.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "query(" src/migrations
rg -n "execute(" src/migrations
rg -n "\$" src/migrations
rg -n "\+" src/migrations

cards.title: Review migration tests and rollback safety
cards.when: Use when a migration change claims to be reversible or includes test changes in a JS or TS codebase.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "rollback" src/migrations
rg -n "function down" src/migrations
ls src/migrations/__tests__
npm test
tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json

cards.title: Verify Tailwind CSS build output exists
cards.when: Use when a CSS build finishes and you need proof the browser will load a stylesheet.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
ls -l dist/assets/styles.css
test -f dist/assets/styles.css
wc -c dist/assets/styles.css

cards.title: Verify built CSS asset references exist
cards.when: Use when a stylesheet contains local asset links and you need proof the files ship with the page.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "url(" dist/assets/styles.css
grep -n "@font-face" dist/assets/styles.css
test -f dist/assets/logo.png
test -f dist/assets/Inter.woff2

cards.title: Verify HTML loads the built stylesheet
cards.when: Use when an HTML page is built and you need proof it references the actual CSS file.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "stylesheet" dist/index.html
grep -n "assets/styles.css" dist/index.html
test -f dist/assets/styles.css
wc -l dist/index.html

cards.title: Verify deployed CSS availability over HTTP
cards.when: Use when a static site is deployed and you need proof the stylesheet is reachable from the server.
cards.cmds:
curl -sI https://example.com/assets/styles.css
curl -sI https://example.com/
date -u

cards.title: Capture missing generated Tailwind class
cards.when: Use when a Tailwind utility class is absent from rendered CSS in a local project.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
grep -rn 'items-center' ./src
grep -c 'items-center' /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Capture conflicting CSS selector rules
cards.when: Use when an element receives two styles and the visible rule seems to override the expected rule.
cards.cmds:
find ./src -name '*.css'
grep -n 'btn-primary' ./src/styles/app.css
grep -n -C 2 'color' ./src/styles/app.css

cards.title: Capture stale HTML class names in markup
cards.when: Use when a page shows old CSS classes after a refactor or code generation.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'card-old' ./src
grep -rn 'card-new' ./src
sed -n '10,20p' ./src/templates/page.html

cards.title: Capture missing stylesheet link in page
cards.when: Use when captured HTML has no CSS loaded or styles are absent.
cards.cmds:
cat ./tmp/capture/page.html
grep -n 'stylesheet' ./tmp/capture/page.html
grep -n 'href' ./tmp/capture/page.html

cards.title: Identify Python project files for review
cards.when: Use when scoping a Python repository to find relevant code and configuration files.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.py' -not -path './.venv/*'
ls pyproject.toml
ls requirements.txt

cards.title: Verify Python test suite and linting
cards.when: Use when reviewing a Python change to ensure quality gates pass before merge.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest -q
python -m mypy .
python -m pip check
python -m pip list

cards.title: Run Python static type checking
cards.when: Use when verifying type hints in Python code during a code review.
cards.cmds:
python -m mypy .
echo $?
ls -la .
